Its Steel segment (Powmex Steels Division) is India's largest manufacturer of High-Speed Steel used in cutting tools for automotive, machine tools, aviation and retail markets. risks.note: The Company's business is closely linked to the global steel industry, particularly the cyclical EAF-based steelmaking segment; any slowdown in steel-consuming sectors such as construction, infrastructure, automotive and manufacturing could reduce steel production levels and consequently graphite electrode demand.

Graphite electrode pricing and margins depend on availability and pricing of key raw materials - petroleum needle coke, raw petroleum coke and coal tar pitch - as well as coking coal prices; supply disruptions or fluctuations in global crude oil / petroleum-linked markets could raise production costs.
risks.risk: Raw material price and availability risk

risks.note: The United States has initiated antidumping and countervailing duty investigations against imports of Large Diameter Graphite Electrodes from India and China, and Brazil has initiated similar investigations; the outcome could affect the terms of US market access for Indian producers such as the Company.

Global steel and graphite electrode markets remain vulnerable to trade-related restrictions, safeguard duties, anti-dumping measures and rapidly evolving carbon-related regulations across regions, adding uncertainty to export opportunities and market conditions.
risks.risk: Rising global trade barriers and carbon-related regulation

risks.note: Elevated Chinese steel exports (estimated around 118 MT in 2025) continue to influence global steel prices and competitive intensity, indirectly pressuring realisations across the steel and graphite electrode value chain.
risks.risk: China steel overcapacity and export pressure

risks.note: Graphite electrode manufacturing is power intensive; any increase in power tariffs or energy costs, together with freight cost volatility, may affect overall cost structures and profitability.
risks.risk: Power-intensive cost structure / energy cost exposure

risks.note: The Company is exposed to currency volatility given its balanced exposure to exports and imports across multiple geographies; while a natural hedge exists from diversified currency exposure, volatility may still affect realisations, procurement costs and profitability.

The graphite electrode industry remains highly competitive, with competition based on pricing, product quality, operational performance, delivery reliability and customer relationships, making sustained competitiveness important for maintaining market position and profitability.
